title: DisasterReady India - Demo Tools & System Self-Test
prompt:
DisasterReady India Developer Demo Tools & Automated System Self-Test Screen.
Key elements:
1. Interactive Demo Tools Toolbar (/demo):
- Quick state toggles: "Pretend I am offline" (outbox queue flush test), "Low-data / Weak signal mode" (disables SVG maps, switches to pure data tables), "Close all roads" (triggers stay-in-place / rescue state), "Fast-forward 6 hours" (stale data warning + capacity penalties), "Simulate 60s Session Timeout", "Advance DR-1042 timeline to next stage".
- Demo staff accounts quick-switch bar (Anita Rao, Vikram Singh, Meena Das, Suresh Patil).
2. Live Automated Self-Test Suite (/selftest & window.runSelfTest()):
- Real executing JS test suite verifying all 14 deterministic specifications:
  (1) Citizen Route Engine: A/B/C routing numbers (A 18m/High, B 24m/Low Recommended, C 28m/None).
  (2) Route Twist: Landslide on e5 switches recommendation to C (+4 min, +0.3 km) and removal restores B.
  (3) Wheelchair accessibility: avoids steep e13, routes via e14.
  (4) Ambulance hospital routing: avoids closed bridge e11 to District Hospital Kharadi.
  (5) Shelter MCDA ranking: S1 > S2, S3 excluded; pregnant need selects CHC Mohanpur.
  (6) Priority ranking: Mohanpur (94.6) -> Lakshmipur (42.3) order and weights sum to 100%.
  (7) Allocation engine: Water 2800/3160 (360 short), Med 140/150 (10 short), Food 1573/1610 (37 short), Blankets 720/760 (40 short); stock never <0, trip capacity enforced.
  (8) Allocation Twist: Block Route 4 adds +35 mins and restricts to tractor-trolley without reducing shortfall; Undo deeply restores baseline plan.
  (9) Citizen Tracking: Invalid request/phone combo returns kind unified error message.
  (10) Staff Auth: 2-step OTP 123456 passes, others fail, 5 failed attempts locks account for 15 min.
  (11) Session Timeout: Inactivity triggers 60s countdown warning then auto-save draft & signout.
  (12) Offline Store: Queues actions in outbox when offline and auto-flushes on reconnect.
  (13) i18n Dictionary: Every English key exists in Hindi dictionary without missing tokens.
  (14) Accessibility: All status elements have icon + text + shape/pattern, passing WCAG contrast.
- Visual pass/fail results table with execution logs and one-click "Run All Tests Again" button.
3. Architecture documentation & API mock replacement comments (// API:).
